value.rationale: The theorem is a complete natural classification of C2-equivalence on all finite abelian groups, explaining why exactly the 2-primary isomorphism type survives while the odd factor collapses to two cardinalities. It gives infinite nonisomorphic equivalent even-order families and a natural exact expressive-power boundary in finite model theory.
